subject: Shared Inference Lab: 'Bring-Your-Model' Group Slot Coordination
messages:
From: Marcel Dupont <marcel@acuity.health>
To: olga.petrov@redwood.ai
Cc: Priya Sharma <priya@brighttower.ai>, Nora Li <nora@nimbusanalytics.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Group lab — running a short 'bring-your-model' session?

Hi Olga,

We run a small engineering working group across a few customers (Acuity Health, BrightTower) and we thought a joint "bring-your-model" inference lab would be valuable: quick 30–45 minute sessions where each team can run a short model through Redwood, verify latency/ops, and ask tuning questions.

Are you running anything like this the next two weeks? If so, can we get a couple of consolidated slot options (best for US PST/Eastern teams)? We can consolidate with one other customer (Nimbus Analytics) if that helps with efficiency and scheduling.

Rough asks from our side:
- 30–45 minute technical walkthrough + 15 minutes for hands-on model runs
- A short agenda and any access prep (sample tokens, model upload instructions)
- Host-provided slot poll so we can pick one that fits engineering calendars

Thanks — Marcel

--
Marcel Dupont
SRE Lead, Acuity Health
marcel@acuity.health

From: olga.petrov@redwood.ai <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Marcel Dupont <marcel@acuity.health>
Cc: Priya Sharma <priya@brighttower.ai>, Nora Li <nora@nimbusanalytics.com>, rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai, vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Group lab — running a short 'bring-your-model' session?

Hi Marcel — great idea, thanks for reaching out. We run these as "Shared Inference Labs" and can absolutely host a consolidated slot. Proposed approach:

1) 45-minute session: 25-minute demo and best-practices, 20 minutes for each team to run a short model (we'll rotate) + 10 minutes for Q&A if time remains.
2) We'll publish a short prep doc and a lightweight checklist (keys, model formats, sample prompt) so your infra team can upload in advance or we can pull from a staging S3.
3) I'll run a quick slot poll and propose three options that cover PST and ET windows.

Proposed windows (PST):
- Option A: Tue Sep 21, 09:00–09:50
- Option B: Wed Sep 22, 12:00–12:50
- Option C: Thu Sep 23, 16:00–16:50 (late slot, useful for EU collaborators)

I'll attach a one-page agenda and the poll link — please indicate preferred slot by EOD Monday and we'll lock it. If you'd like a dedicated breakout after the group lab for deeper tuning, we can schedule a follow-up.

Attaching: group-lab-agenda.pdf, slot-poll.ics

Best,
Olga Petrov
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.ai

From: Priya Sharma <priya@brighttower.ai>
To: olga.petrov@redwood.ai
Cc: Marcel Dupont <marcel@acuity.health>, Nora Li <nora@nimbusanalytics.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Sep 2026 08:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Group lab — running a short 'bring-your-model' session?

Thanks Olga — Option B (Wed Sep 22, 12:00–12:50 PST) looks best for BrightTower engineering. Two quick notes:

- We'll bring a 6B encoder-decoder conversational model (ONNX) — can you confirm we can stage a 6B model ahead of time?
- Could you add a 5–10 minute slot for quick cost/throughput knobs? That's a common ask.

From: rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: olga.petrov@redwood.ai
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.ai, vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 14 Sep 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Shared Inference Lab — logistics + infra checklist

Olga — adding a quick infra checklist before we lock Option B:

- Please ask customers to share model formats (TorchScript/ONNX/gguf) and approximate fp (f32/int8) + model size.
- Confirm whether they want us to pre-stage models on our staging S3 (we need access details) or upload during the session.
- Provide expected concurrency during hands-on runs (tokens/sec expectation) so we can size the demo instance.
- We'll offer a short segment on cost/throughput knobs — I'll cover batching, KV caching, and quantization tradeoffs.

If customers confirm Option B by EOD Tue 9/15, we'll publish a calendar invite with breakout links and a shared drive with the prep doc.

Rishi
Principal Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai

Cc: Marcel Dupont <marcel@acuity.health>, Priya Sharma <priya@brighttower.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Shared Inference Lab — confirmed slot (Wed Sep 22 12:00 PST)

Hi all — Nimbus confirms Option B as well. We appreciate the checklist, Rishi. A couple of specifics from our side:

- We'll upload a 2.7B NLU model (gguf) to the staging S3; Nora will share S3 write creds via secure link before EOD Wed.
- We prefer pre-staging so we can avoid time lost in the hands-on rotation.
- Yes please include the 5–10 minute cost/throughput knobs segment.

Looking forward — please send the calendar invite and the short prep doc.

Thanks,
Nora Li
Product Infra, Nimbus Analytics
--
Nora Li
nora@nimbusanalytics.com
